es-eu-straight.name: Straight and heavy-duty punches, 45° – 88°
es-eu-straight.summary: The everyday punch for air bending to 90°: a straight body with an 88° or 85° tip — 85° leaves room to over-bend stainless and high-strength steel that springs back further — in working heights from 65 to 135 mm (2.56 – 5.31″), plus 75°, 60° and 45° punches for acute bends and deeper parts. es-acc-upper.name: Intermediates and upper adapters
es-acc-upper.summary: The intermediate is the holder between the ram and a European-style punch: it carries the clamp and, on the adjustable versions, a wedge that crowns each section so the angle stays true along the bend. Z1 intermediates have a 27 mm (1.06″) body with the bending axis 7 mm from the face; Z2 intermediates a 40 mm (1.57″) body with the axis at 20 mm; the heavy-duty versions are solid CrMo steel. The upper adapters go the other way: they let a press brake with Trumpf / Wila, Beyeler, LVD, Weinbrenner, CBC, EHT, Durmazlar, Darley, Baykal or Colgar clamping run European-style punches — or a European-style beam run Trumpf / Wila punches.

es-acc-adjustable.name: Adjustable dies, V 24 – 400 mm
es-acc-adjustable.summary: For plate and for shops that bend many thicknesses: one adjustable die replaces a rack of 1V dies. Spacer bars set the V opening between the two halves, and case-hardened rollers on the shoulders let the plate slide in instead of dragging, so it is not marked and less force is needed. Four sizes from V24 to V400 mm (.94 – 15.75″), rated from 125 to 600 t/m (42 – 202 US t/ft) at 90°; each comes with its spacer set and 5 m of protective film and needs its own lower adapter.

es-acc-urethane.name: Urethane and nylon dies, protective film
es-acc-urethane.summary: For stainless, aluminum, painted and pre-finished sheet that must not be marked: a urethane insert in its holder works as a die that the punch presses the sheet into — no V, no shoulders, no marks — and nylon inserts replace the steel shoulders of a V. Where the steel die stays, a urethane film or a protective cloth over the V keeps the shoulders off the part.
